system.description:
You create a Ranging wave of sticky bubbles and spray it out in a cone in front of you creating a sticky and adhesive ground. Each Creature standing in the affected area, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save affected creatures take 2d8 cold damage and are Restrained in place until the end of their next turn.

If you have a sufficient water source nearby, reduce the chakra cost of this jutsu by 2 or you can choose to cast it as a bonus action.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the size of the cone by 10 feet. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher creatures who fail their saving throw are first pushed back 10 feet before being Restrained in place. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the damage dealt by +2d8. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can change the shape of this jutsu to be Self (60-Foot Line). If cast in this way all affected creatures make their saving throw with a -2 penalty. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the damage dealt by +2d8.
